input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "I have faith that you'll guide me well, and I'd be grateful for your help. I have an exam next week that I failed last year, and I'm very anxious about it. How can I manage the anxiety and prepare?"
Message B: "I have an exam next week that I failed last year, and I'm very anxious about it. How can I manage the anxiety and prepare?"

Which writer comes across as more **warm, polite and considerate**?
(Kind, respectful, cooperative and trusting.)

Answer "A" or "B".
